claims.claim_text: Richard E Clark has a confirmed match to the exact name and private identifier in the official Army merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The private identifier selects one exact-name record among twenty-four Richard E Clark Army rows and dates Army entry to 7 May 1942.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier and exact indexed name are decisive among numerous common-name candidates.
claims.temporal_assessment: The record dates Army entry but does not date OSS service or prove the occupational category was immediately prior.
claims.match_notes: The matched row records an enlisted grade. No branch, employer or immediate OSS predecessor is inferred.

claims.claim_text: An official Army-entry record assigns Richard E Clark the broad occupational category Chauffeurs and drivers, bus, taxi, truck, and tractor; no employer is identified.
